About this item

  • FRESH FOAM CUSHIONING — Precision engineered Fresh Foam midsole cushioning is designed to deliver an ultra-cushioned, lightweight ride
  • EVERYDAY RUNNING SHOE — Built for everyday running and all-day wear, this women’s running shoe combines soft cushioning with neutral support
  • BREATHABLE ENGINEERED MESH — Synthetic materials and breathable engineered mesh help create a durable, versatile runner for daily use
  • LIGHTWEIGHT FEEL — Weighing only 208.2 grams, the lightweight design helps keep the shoe feeling light while supporting comfortable wear for workouts and active days
  • LACE-UP CLOSURE — Lace closure provides a secure, adjustable fit, while the approximate 10 mm heel-to-toe drop* gives the shoe a familiar running profile

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

Customers say

Customers find these running shoes excellent for walking and running, with good arch support for high arches and appropriate cushioning for shock absorption. They are comfortable, lightweight, and offer good value for money. The fit receives mixed feedback - while some find the wide size fits well, others report issues with sizing. Durability is also mixed, with some finding them durable while others report quick wear on the soles.

    Can’t say enough good things about these shoes. This is my second pair. I have high arches, two forms of neuropathy, Rheumatoid Arthritis and walk on the outside of my feet. Comfortable shoes are hard to find and these work beautifully for me. I use cloud insoles in them for extra cushion and they’re the most supportive, dependable shoes I’ve ever worn. The extra width keeps the nerve pain down and allows me to spend more time up and moving. I’ve tried umpteen tennis shoes and spent a ridiculous amount of money trying to find a good pair. This kind of comfort and they’re not $200 a pop is fabulous. I appreciate so much that they don’t look like Herman Munster shoes as well. They’re actually normal looking! Love these.

About this Item

  • FRESH FOAM CUSHIONING — Precision engineered Fresh Foam midsole cushioning is designed to deliver an ultra-cushioned, lightweight ride
  • EVERYDAY RUNNING SHOE — Built for everyday running and all-day wear, this women’s running shoe combines soft cushioning with neutral support
  • BREATHABLE ENGINEERED MESH — Synthetic materials and breathable engineered mesh help create a durable, versatile runner for daily use
  • LIGHTWEIGHT FEEL — Weighing only 208.2 grams, the lightweight design helps keep the shoe feeling light while supporting comfortable wear for workouts and active days
  • LACE-UP CLOSURE — Lace closure provides a secure, adjustable fit, while the approximate 10 mm heel-to-toe drop* gives the shoe a familiar running profile

Product Description

The New Balance Women's Fresh Foam 520v9 Running Shoe is a durable, versatile runner designed for everyday running and all-day wear. Precision-engineered Fresh Foam midsole cushioning helps deliver an ultra-cushioned, lightweight ride, while breathable engineered mesh and synthetic materials support daily comfort. Soft cushioning and neutral support make this women’s running shoe a practical option for workouts, casual activity, and active days. A lace closure helps provide an adjustable fit, and the approximate 10 mm heel-to-toe drop* offers a familiar running shoe feel. *A shoe's "drop" is the height difference from the heel of the shoe to the forefoot. Shoes with a higher drop tend to be favored by runners who land heel-first. lower drops are often favored by forefoot or midfoot strikers.
